+++ b/fix_markdown.py
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+
+import sys
+
+file_path = 'rich/markdown.py'
+with open(file_path, 'r') as f:
+    content = f.read()
+
+old_text = """    def __init__(self, justify: JustifyMethod) -> None:
+        self.content: TextType = ""
+        self.justify = justify
+
+    def on_text(self, context: "MarkdownContext", text: TextType) -> None:
+        plain = text.plain if isinstance(text, Text) else text
+        self.content = plain"""
+
+new_text = """    def __init__(self, justify: JustifyMethod) -> None:
+        self.content = Text(justify=justify)
+        self.justify = justify
+
+    def on_text(self, context: "MarkdownContext", text: TextType) -> None:
+        self.content.append(text, context.style_stack.current if isinstance(text, str) else None)"""
+
+new_content = content.replace(old_text, new_text)
+
+with open(file_path, 'w') as f:
+    f.write(new_content)
